title: IKEv2: Begin process of renamining isakmp to ike
description:
IKEv2 "combines the contents of what were previously separate documents,
including Internet Security Association and Key Management Protocol
(ISAKMP, RFC 2408)"[1] and "describes such a protocol -- the Internet
Key Exchange --... intended to replace all three of those RFCs."[2,3,4]

ISAKMP and IKEv2 both have IANA assigned Security Protocol Identifiers
parameter tables. The former has an entry for "PROTO_ISAKMP"[5] whereas
the latter has an entry only for "IKE"[6] (for the same value, though the
tables are not entirely compatible, unlike some other corresponding tables).

From its beginning, IKEv2 was intended to replace ISAKMP, and now RFC
9395 has officially deprecated IKEv1 and moved RFCs 2407, 2408, and 2409
to Historic Status, also closing all ISAKMP and IKEv1 registries.[7,8,9]
Of particular note, RFC 9395 prefers referring to the collection of RFCs
2407, 2408, and 2409 as "IKEv1" instead of "ISAKMP," mentioning "ISAKMP"
only in places where it is in the title of an existing document (e.g.
the IANA '"Magic Numbers" for ISAKMP Protocol' registries and RFC 2408.)

Therefore, change the protocol registration and filter names from "isakmp"
to "ike" and set "isakmp" as an alias, similar to what was done with
"bootp" and "dhcp" and "ssl" and "tls." Common use also supports the idea
of "IKE" being preferred as the protocol name.

Fix #20620

1 - https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc4306
2 - https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc4306#section-1
3 - https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5996#section-1
4 - https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7296#section-1
5 - https://www.iana.org/assignments/isakmp-registry/isakmp-registry.xhtml#isakmp-registry-3
6 - https://www.iana.org/assignments/ikev2-parameters/ikev2-parameters.xhtml#ikev2-parameters-18
7 - https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9395
8 - https://www.iana.org/assignments/isakmp-registry/isakmp-registry.xhtml
9 - https://www.iana.org/assignments/ipsec-registry/ipsec-registry.xhtml

@@ -107,6 +107,12 @@ Qualcomm Diagnostic (QCDIAG)
 
 Too many protocol updates have been made to list them all here.
 
+Of particular note, "ike" is now preferred to "isakmp" for filtering the
+Internet Key Exchange (IKE) protocol and its fields (both IKEv1 and IKEv2),
+including fields primarily associated with RFC 2408, Internet Security
+Association and Key Management Protocol (ISAKMP) though "isakmp" remains as
+an alias for the protocol and all its fields.
